PM Modi meets Putin, other leaders at SCO Summit

Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin and other world leaders at the SCO Summit in Bishkek. Modi engaged in "car diplomacy" with Putin, driving together to the opening ceremony of the Nomad Sports complex. Modi also extended an invitation to the BRICS summit. The discussions between Modi and Putin reportedly focused on bilateral relations and regional issues.
